_about: Academic values of the Writing marking (Bandzilla last prompt, 2026-10-26). Owned by the academic lead: change a value here, not in the code. Loaded by services/ai/marking_config.py; a missing key falls back to the default in that file. Every value marked review=true was set by the developer and still needs the academic lead's approval.

density._about: Weighted checked mistakes per 100 words, per criterion (Grammar, Lexical Resource). A slip (typo, missing full stop, one article or plural slip) counts as slip_weight.
density._changed_slip: 2026-10-29: slip_weight 0.5->0.25 - a slip is 'very small, allowed even at Band 9' (the academic lead's three classes: error, slip, alternative; approved 2026-10-29).
density._changed: 2026-10-27: band9 0.5->0.4, band8 and the Band 8 start 1.2->0.8 - at 1.2 the owner's #37 (Grammar 1.4 weighted per 100 words) got Grammar 8 and #38 (Lexical 1.3) Lexical 8, overall 7.5 and 8.0 against the expected 6.5-7.0 and 7.0-7.5; 0.8 is the deployed guide's 'Band 8: about 1-3 slips in a 250-350-word essay'. Proposal for the academic lead.

floors._about: The least band a long-enough answer (Task 1 150+ words, Task 2 250+) gets on Lexical Resource and Grammar for what it shows - never on Task Achievement/Response or Coherence (the academic lead, 2026-10-29). wide_range_phrases: strong phrases the examiner marked that count as a wide range. slips_only_min: the band when that criterion has only slips (no error). clear_vocabulary_lr_min: Lexical Resource when the range is wide, no word makes the meaning unclear and the errors stay under the Band 7 density.

model_answer._about: Openers no model answer uses: they came back in report after report (the academic lead, 2026-10-29). The student's last three model answers' paragraph openers are avoided too.
Openers no model answer uses: they came back in report after report (the academic lead, 2026-10-29). The student's last three model answers' paragraph openers are avoided too.

anchors._about: Fixed anchors in every scoring run (ids from data/calibration/book_samples.json). Band 9 anchors from Volume 1: v1-p028 (Task 1) and v1-p026 (Task 2), outside the 12-sample B4 set - confirmed by the academic lead on 2026-10-27 (option A).

type_anchors._about: Task 1: the scoring runs also see the Band 9 report of the same kind of visual (line, bar, table, pie, process, cycle, mixed) from Ilhom Alijanov's IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 Masterclass, in data/calibration/type_anchors.json - never the report being scored itself. Chosen by the academic lead on 2026-10-27.

calibration._about: B4 test-set changes. remove = left out of the test set; expect = the band the test set expects instead of the book's.

v1-p008.why: The Ireland report swaps the two series; the book's 8.0 would teach the grader to ignore data errors.

progress._about: A submission shorter than this is not used as 'your previous report' on the progress page (report #48 compared itself with #47, a 46-word test).

regression._about: Expected results of scripts/writing_regression.py for the owner's reports (essay numbers).
